metadata.question: Does vegetation cover increase in the Taklamakan Desert near Hotan from February 23, 2020 to April 29, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Taklamakan Desert near Hotan (approximately 37.1°N, 79.9°E) - Dates: February 23, 2020 and April 29, 2020 - Collection: Sentinel-2 (good for NDVI/vegetation analysis, 10m resolution) - Fallback: Landsat 8 if Sentinel-2 unavailable 2. Masking strategy: - Apply cloud masking (QA60 for Sentinel-2) to get valid pixels - Calculate mean NDVI for both periods - Compare: does April NDVI > February NDVI? 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check image counts for both periods - Check valid pixel counts after cloud masking (if 0, output C2) - Validate NDVI values are in [-1, 1] range - If calculation fails or NaN, output C3 - Compare mean NDVI values: if April > February, answer A; else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Hotan/Taklamakan area const hotan = ee.Geometry.Point([79.9, 37.1]); const aoi = hotan.buffer(50000); // 50km buffer // Date ranges const startFeb = '2020-02-15'; const endFeb = '2020-03-05'; const startApr = '2020-04-15'; const endApr = '2020-05-10'; // Sentinel-2 with cloud masking const s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(aoi) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); // February collection const febCollection = s2.filterDate(startFeb, endFeb); const febCount = febCollection.size().getInfo(); // April collection const aprCollection = s2.filterDate(startApr, endApr); const aprCount = aprCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb Images: ${febCount}, Apr Images: ${aprCount}`); if (febCount === 0 || aprCount === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Function to calculate NDVI and valid pixels function calculateNDVI(collection) { return collection.map(img => { const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); const cloudMask = img.select('QA60') .bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0) .and(img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)); return ndvi.updateMask(cloudMask); }).mean(); } const febNDVI = calculateNDVI(febCollection); const aprNDVI = calculateNDVI(aprCollection); // Check valid pixels for February const febValidPixels = febNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); // Check valid pixels for April const aprValidPixels = aprNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb Valid Pixels: ${febValidPixels}, Apr Valid Pixels: ${aprValidPixels}`); if (febValidPixels === 0 || aprValidPixels === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI const febMean = febNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const aprMean = aprNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb Mean NDVI: ${febMean !== null ? febMean.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Apr Mean NDVI: ${aprMean !== null ? aprMean.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); if (febMean === null || aprMean === null || isNaN(febMean) || isNaN(aprMean)) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (febMean < -1 || febMean > 1 || aprMean < -1 || aprMean > 1) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare vegetation cover const ndviIncrease = aprMean > febMean; console.log(`NDVI Increase (Apr > Feb): ${ndviIncrease}`); if (ndviIncrease) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
